description: This file defines a TypeScript module for executing HTTP GET requests, including schema creation, request handling, and a class extending a dynamic tool for making GET requests with configurable URL, headers, and query parameters.

classes.name: RequestsGetTool
classes.description: A class extending DynamicStructuredTool to perform configurable GET requests with dynamic URL, headers, and query parameters.

methods.name: createRequestsGetSchema
methods.description: Creates a Zod schema for GET request query parameters based on an optional JSON schema string.

methods.name: _call
methods.description: Performs the GET request with URL and query parameters, handling path and query parameter insertion, and returns the response text truncated to maxOutputLength.
